offer.question: Have you coached on another platform before?
offer.questionSir: Have you coached on another platform before, sir?
offer.value: Would you like to bring your clients and coaching history into TGP?

source.title: Where are your records?
source.body: Choose a shortcut, or enter another site. Available records are checked on your computer.
source.note: A listed site is a shortcut, not a guarantee that every record can be imported.
source.customHint: Enter the secure web address you use to sign in.
source.invalid: Enter a valid public HTTPS address.
source.noCredentials: Do not include a password or sign-in code.

handoff.title: Continue on a computer
handoff.body: You will need Chrome on a computer. Keep this setup open while you connect the TGP extension.
handoff.stepOne: Open this setup on your computer.
handoff.stepThree: Sign in to your source and review Start.
handoff.noComputer: I will use a computer later

progress.title: Import in progress
progress.unknownTotal: The full source total is not known yet.
progress.stale: Updates are unavailable. The import's current status has not been confirmed.
progress.offlineStop: This phone is offline. Stop the import from the extension on your computer.

complete.title: Your records are ready
complete.roman: I have checked the imported records in TGP. They are ready to use.
complete.neutral: The imported records have been checked in TGP and are ready to use.

partial.title: Some records are ready
partial.body: Review the verified records and the items that still need attention.

unconfirmed.title: Some records are unconfirmed
unconfirmed.body: These records may already have reached TGP. Their transfer has not been confirmed.

result.coverageUnknown: Source completeness has not been confirmed.
result.nativeUnknown: Availability in TGP has not been confirmed.

failed.title: Import did not complete
failed.body: Review the confirmed records and the items that could not be completed.

interrupted.title: Import was interrupted
interrupted.body: The current result needs to be checked before another attempt.

timeout.title: This import attempt reached its time limit
timeout.body: Review the records that were confirmed before deciding what to do next.

cancelled.title: Import stopped
cancelled.body: Records already written may remain in TGP. Review the confirmed result.

result.zero: No records were found in the checked scope.
result.transferOnly: Transfer confirmed. Availability in TGP has not been confirmed.
result.reasonUnknown: The import needs attention before it can continue.
result.unavailable: The import result is unavailable right now. Check the current result again.

reasons.denied: Access was not granted. Allow access to the selected source to continue.
reasons.scopeUnknown: The source account could not be confirmed. Check the selected tab before continuing.
reasons.changed: The source account changed. This import cannot continue with a different account.
